column1: # bin/links.tsv — commands that live in another repository.
# ~/.local/bin is on PATH, so a symlink there makes a command global. The
# command itself is not ours to store: it belongs to the repo in the second
# column. This file records the mapping so a new machine can recreate every
# link it has the repo for, and say which ones it skipped.
# Paths are relative to $HOME. install.sh links a row only when its target
# exists, the same way .zshrc guards every tool it touches.
